title: Vertex AI Claude endpoints reject unsupported anthropic-beta values; filter them per endpoint with vertex_anthropic_betas
answers: Claude on Vertex AI returns 400 Unexpected value(s) for the anthropic-beta header
Claude Code request fails through a Vertex AI gateway endpoint with a beta header error
How do I stop client anthropic-beta values from being forwarded to Vertex?
Vertex rejects a beta like advisor-tool-2026-03-01 on passthrough requests
body:
Symptom: a client using a newer Anthropic feature (e.g. Claude Code's advisor-tool-2026-03-01 beta) gets a 400 "Unexpected value(s) ... for the anthropic-beta header" on every request through a Vertex AI Claude endpoint.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py:AnthropicProvider._get_headers merges client headers into the upstream request, so the client's anthropic-beta reaches Vertex unchanged. Vertex rejects the whole request on an unknown value; the Anthropic API ignores it.
Fix pattern: filter in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers before calling super(), using _filter_anthropic_betas and VertexAIConfig.vertex_anthropic_betas. Keep the shared Anthropic merge untouched.
Constraints: None forwards the header unchanged (default), [] drops it, a non-empty list keeps only listed values and drops the header if none remain. Runs after _drop_client_auth_headers. Gemini and MaaS paths must not be affected.
applies: Passthrough and raw proxy routes of Claude-on-Vertex endpoints in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py; not Gemini or MaaS providers.
says: Requests to Claude on Vertex AI fail with unexpected beta header errors.
Calling gateway endpoints using developer tools fails because unsupported beta flags are forwarded.
Filter out unsupported beta feature headers on Vertex AI Claude gateway endpoints.
Allow configuring allowed beta headers per endpoint so upstream cloud providers accept requests.
search: Filter unsupported anthropic-beta request headers for Claude-on-Vertex endpoints in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py using _filter_anthropic_betas and VertexAIConfig.vertex_anthropic_betas. Filtering occurs in _VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers before calling super(), leaving AnthropicProvider._get_headers untouched. Setting vertex_anthropic_betas to None forwards headers unchanged, an empty list drops the header, and a non-empty list retains only matching values. Applies specifically to passthrough and raw proxy routes for Claude on Vertex AI, while Gemini and MaaS routes must not be affected.
